title: Add explicit memory repair commands
summary: Turn read-only memory drift reports into explicit operator-controlled repair commands for stale parents, missing provenance, and settlement mismatches.
expectedFailureModes: A repair command mutates memory without a dry-run path or before/after evidence.
A stale parent repair clears a parent reference that changed after the drift report was generated.
A destructive delete runs without an explicit apply mode and operator reason.
A provenance backfill overwrites existing metadata instead of preserving useful record context.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd verify -- --nocapture
humanEscalation: Approval before destructive automatic memory deletion or settlement backfill
nextAction: Wire daemon IPC, HTTP, CLI, and audit rows for memory repair primitives once the existing unrelated daemon/CLI worktree changes are safe to edit.
